FN-YL1P262-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 165
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Rick Rehm
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 02/13/2025
House Bill 165 as introduced would not directly affect state or local funding.
Page 1

FN-YL1P262-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 165
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Rick Rehm
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 03/19/2025
House Bill 165 as reported by the committee on State Government could increase the
obligations of state agencies required to provide services on state holidays by a minimal,
undetermined amount to provide compensatory leave or paid compensation in lieu of the state
holiday to employees working on the state holiday dependent upon the compensation of the
employees.
Page 1

FN-YL1P262-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 165
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Rick Rehm
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 04/28/2025
House Bill 165 as passed the House of Representatives could increase the obligations of state
agencies required to provide services on the Juneteenth state holiday by a minimal,
undetermined amount, dependent upon the compensation of the employees, to provide
compensatory leave or paid compensation in lieu of the state holiday to employees that work on
the Juneteenth state holiday.
